EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at ~2888/2918 cm⁻¹ and CH₂ bending/scissoring in the 1440–1480 cm⁻¹ region (consistent with GFQ-003). A pronounced band at 1079 cm⁻¹ is typical for a C–O stretch of an aliphatic alcohol, and the features at 826 and 893 cm⁻¹ are compatible with cyclohexane ring modes. The absence of a ~1375 cm⁻¹ CH₃ symmetric deformation band disfavors candidates containing CH₃; the absence of N–H stretches (~3300 cm⁻¹) disfavors amine-containing candidates. Cyclohexylmethanol (candidate 4) best matches this CH₂-only cyclic alcohol pattern.
